title: Triangle Center Mass
claim: Tests whether a three-axis simplex can steer selection among many federation fronts by projecting all fronts as points and ranking them against a movable desired intent vector.
selection: score = 0.77 simplex similarity + 0.23 existing experimental FCM score
pins: up to three local fronts; their centroid is rendered as actual center of mass against the desired cursor
known_limits: Profiles are heuristic projections from current public registry metadata and operator mappings.
A three-axis lens cannot represent every relevant decision dimension simultaneously.
The triangle remains a lens over many fronts, not a claim that work itself is intrinsically ternary.
Pinned center of mass is an arithmetic centroid in the active lens, not an objective portfolio optimum.
